pieces.Text: As a standard action, you can treat a willing, adjacent creature to remove the shaken, sickened, or staggered condition. This doesn't end the effect that caused the condition, and the target can regain the condition from any source as normal. You can use this ability a number of times equal to your key ability score modifier (
). You regain all expended uses of this ability (up to your maximum) when you take a 10-minute rest to recover Stamina.
